catalogue_requests.reason: cap.measure.spectrum.v1 requires wavelength_min and wavelength_max and carries no ASTEP, ATIME or gain; the AS7341 has eight fixed bands and its command takes those three integration settings, so no catalogue class expresses the real invoke input.
catalogue_requests.summary: Measure the eight fixed AS7341 bands through the current NeoPixel color with ASTEP, ATIME and gain, returning the channel centres, intensities and computed integration time.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: no hardware was attached or run, and the hardware backend (native.py) was never executed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family/helper is python-object/PythonObjectDriver, but the real interface is the two text commands set_color(R, G, B) and read_sensor(astep, atime, gain) sent through the Talker serial class; the family grammar binds one native method per command and Talker.send returns no reply, so it cannot express the send-then-receive measurement, and the package is a direct Driver over the entry symbol. The driver sends the three-argument read_sensor form used by the host helper (src/self_driving_lab_demo/utils/observe.py:376-377); the nonwireless firmware branch at src/extra/nonwireless/main.py:48-50 unpacks two arguments and then calls a three-argument read_sensor, so a reviewer must confirm or repair that firmware before hardware use. Talker frames a command with CR FF and expects an echo (src/extra/nonwireless/lib/host_nonwireless.py:12-20); the fake answers the two commands in memory and is synthetic, not a recording of the device. Only the nonwireless light demo is covered; the repository's liquid, solid and MQTT paths are not. The risk is R1 because cap.device.configure.v1 carries an R1 class floor; no operator-required bound is used. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
